## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`npm test`) and I added tests for new behavior
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` are clean
- [ ] I added a changeset (`npx changeset`) describing the change and its bump level — required for anything
      user-facing (skip only for internal/CI/docs-only changes)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`type(scope): summary`)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or the CLI surface changed
